summary.intent: Execute all 5 plans in Phase 50 (IPFS/IPNS Data-Integrity Fixes) using wave-based parallel worktree execution, then run a code review gate before proceeding to verification and shipping.
summary.outcome: All 5 plans executed and merged across 2 waves (Wave 1: 50-01/02/03/05 in parallel; Wave 2: 50-04). Post-merge gates passed (93/93 targeted tests, typecheck clean). Code review found 2 confirmed blockers (cycle guard missing in 50-03's new traversal, unhandled rejections in 4 dispatch sites) and a fixer agent was dispatched — phase not yet complete.

repo: pnpm/orval resolves to the workspace root, not to the active worktree — api-client regeneration (132 files) and SDK `client.ts` changes leak into the main checkout when any worktree agent runs `pnpm api:generate` or `pnpm install`
husky auto-generates `.husky/_/` stub files inside any worktree that runs pnpm commands; these show as untracked and block the cleanup-wave merge helper

The pre-commit hook runs `check-api-client.sh` + `pnpm lint-staged` (eslint+prettier across all staged api-client files); on 131-file merges this takes long enough to silently stall the cleanup-wave helper's internal commit
The `gsd_run query commit` helper reports `commit_failed` as a false-negative even when the commit succeeds — must verify with `git log`
The `gsd_run query init.manager` dep-string parser mis-reads 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)' as a phantom phase '1.1', producing a false dep-unsatisfied state for Phase 50

`collectSubtreeIpnsNamesAsync` in packages/sdk/src/client.ts was written without a visited/cycle guard despite its docstring claiming to mirror `ensureFolderLoaded`'s DFS pattern — sibling functions at lines 549 and 2526 both have cycle guards
TDD commit convention: RED commit prefixed `test(N-NN):` → GREEN commit prefixed `fix/feat(N-NN):`; plans not typed `tdd` (disposition plans) are exempt from the TDD gate
CAPACITY.md (section 7) documents BYO retention consequences for refcount semantics; this is the canonical reference for quota/unpin lifecycle decisions
Two orphan worktree branches (`worktree-agent-a92edd36`, `worktree-agent-abd7998d`) from a prior session exist with no attached worktrees

code.finding: collectSubtreeIpnsNamesAsync recurses at lines 220, 246, 316 with no visited set — a folder cycle causes unbounded recursion and deleteItem failure, directly contradicting the phase's data-integrity goal
ensureFolderLoaded carries a visited/cycle guard that collectSubtreeIpnsNamesAsync should mirror but doesn't
Shared walker also carries a cycle guard, establishing the pattern collectSubtreeIpnsNamesAsync must follow
Refcount guard added by 50-02: skips physical unpin when CID is re-pinned during drain
50-02 added refcount guard here; 50-04 confirmed this is the integration point for the row-deleted flag gating metricsService.fileUnpins

workflow: When cleanup-wave helper fails silently with `merge_failed` and empty stderr, a MERGE_HEAD is likely in progress — complete the merge manually with `git merge --no-ff` or by committing the already-staged index rather than aborting and retrying
Post-merge test gates should target changed packages specifically (not `pnpm --parallel -r run test`) to avoid RAM starvation and infra-dependent integration test failures
Verify leaked generated files match the worktree's committed version before discarding them — if they match, a simple `git checkout -- .` is safe; if they differ, investigate before discarding

When a worktree base-check returns `baseref-head`, worktrees fork off current HEAD and will contain all plan files — the key-link failure for 'upcoming wave's own deliverable' is a forward-reference artifact, not a real gap

Code review blockers that contradict the phase's own stated goal (e.g., a traversal fix that introduces a new traversal cycle) must be fixed before shipping, even if the executor's targeted tests passed

friction: cleanup-wave helper failed three times for the 50-05 worktree: first due to untracked husky stubs, then due to 131 leaked api-client files in the main checkout, then due to a stalled pre-commit hook leaving MERGE_HEAD set — required manual merge completion
pnpm/orval api-client generation inside a worktree pollutes the main checkout, requiring per-merge leak inspection and `git checkout -- .` before each subsequent worktree merge
init.manager dep-string parser created a phantom phase '1.1' from 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)', suppressing the Execute Phase 50 recommendation and requiring manual override
gsd commit helper false-negative (`commit_failed`) on every tracking commit required `git log` verification after each call
macOS `mktemp` with mid-template Xs (`XXXXXX` not at end) doesn't substitute — wave manifest got a literal filename with Xs, not a random suffix
